cards.en: How do you do? (very formal, first meeting)
Please take care of me. / I look forward to working with you.
Welcome. (said to someone who comes in)

quiz.q: You meet your new boss for the first time. What is the best thing to say?
quiz.why: 처음 뵙겠습니다 is the formal way to greet someone you meet for the first time.

quiz.q: A customer walks into your shop. What do you say?
quiz.why: 어서 오세요 means welcome. The shop says it to the person who comes in.
-에서 왔어요 means came from. 일본에서 = from Japan.

quiz.q: Which question asks about someone's nationality?
quiz.why: 어느 나라 사람이에요? literally asks which country person you are.

quiz.q: Before bed, you say good night to your grandmother.
quiz.why: 안녕히 주무세요 is the respectful form of good night for an older person.
